title: Mixed Event — Musical Twilight Parade — Episode1 Indecision

meta.Event Outline: Shiho has been scouted by a band that's ready to make its big debut, giving her a lot to think about. Then, Saki invites her on a visit to Phoenix Wonderland. Meanwhile, Tsukasa and the rest of WxS make their own preparations, eager to host them!

rows.Line: Live House

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I've finished cleaning up, so I'll be leaving now.
Thank you for today.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Yeah, thanks for your help!
Your performance was stellar as usual.
Take it easy now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Nice to see you again, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
What do you want this time?
I already told you, I'm not joining your band.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
I know, but...
I was just wondering if you changed your mind.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I haven't...
I'm staying with my current band.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Well, that's really a shame...
I was hoping you'd say yes today.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Well, I'll be back again soon so...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Hehe... Isn't this where you say something like, Don't bother. I don't care how many times you try...?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: This means you really ARE considering my offer, no?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I... I have to go now...!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Wait!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What is it...?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
This is a ticket for our next performance.
Come and see us for yourself.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I'll sing with everything I have if it means you'll join.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But... Why me...?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Didn't I say so before?
It's because I like your sound.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Plus, our band is making its debut under a major label soon. I want to do that with the best team possible.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wouldn't you prefer to stick with the ones you've worked so hard with all this time...?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Hehe. So you're the sentimental type?
I really wasn't expecting that...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Playing in a band as a hobby and doing it professionally are completely different things. You won't make it as a pro unless you absolutely commit to it.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Those who can't end up bringing down everyone else's morale and just make things difficult for themselves on top of that.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Which is why I don't want bandmates who're only playing for fun and don't have the resolve to really take it seriously.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I was under the impression that you were of the same mind.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I... Well...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: We have a night performance this weekend. If you're still on the fence, come and see us play before making a decision.
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho, how did I do just now?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Your not hitting those high notes right, Ichika.
The song lacked impact overall,
especially during the chorus.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
S-Sorry!
I'll make sure to practice more.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Honami, you lost focus during the second half,
and I heard mistakes here and there.
Saki also got dragged in and lost sync.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I-I'm so sorry!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ugh... This is sooo hard...
Especially the rhythm for this part.
I can't wrap my head around it...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But that also means once you do get it, you'll figure out the best way to move and position your fingers.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's true... Okay, thanks!
Practice makes perfect and all that, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: As long as you're not overworking yourself, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'll be careful!
No mistakes next time then!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(I'll need to practice more too...
If I really want to become a pro...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, Shiho, do you have a minute?
I was hoping for some advice about the chorus...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
...
Yeah, sure.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry! I know you have your own part to work on...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Quit apologizing and let's practice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I do want to get better, but together... With all of you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Shiho...
Right, thank you.
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Sigh...
We got so much practice in today too...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We sure did! I'll definitely sleep like a baby tonight.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Both of you have improved quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Do you mean that?!
Yaaay!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, I could tell just by listening too.
You've really been improving.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I have to try to keep up...
